class.name: HTMLTableCellElement
class.brief_description: An HTML table data cell or header cell.

members.member: The short label of a header cell.
Zero-based position in the parent row or [code]-1[/code] without a row parent.
The reflected column span. Reads are limited to 1 through 1000.
The source attribute listing header IDs.
The reflected row span. Reads are limited to 0 through 65534. Zero spans the remaining rows in the row group.
The canonical header scope keyword. Missing and unknown values read as an empty string.
